control_flow_findings: require_elevated_filesystem_isolation() takes no configuration, root, token or ACL arguments and unconditionally returns ElevatedWindowsSandboxIsolationUnavailable.
elevated_impl::run_windows_sandbox_capture_for_permission_profile invokes this guard before permission resolution, Codex-home creation, capability setup, ACL mutation and runner transport.

The first two original Core positives explicitly select WindowsSandboxLevel::Elevated and require a real successful child. The third selects the elevated UnifiedExec path; the original failure occurs during its filesystem-helper session initialization.

Creating a better test directory or modifying only fixture ACLs cannot change this unconditional control flow. Replacing Elevated, expecting refusal, skipping, filtering or granting an environment/test bypass would change the acceptance contract.

Current c4ae source already contains full-restriction candidates and role separation. It is inaccurate to describe every c4ae token path as still using WRITE_RESTRICTED. Nevertheless their existence is not production qualification, and the unchanged admission guard is decisive.
candidate_component_limits: UnqualifiedFullRestrictionToken exposes a native mechanism, not a filesystem launch qualification.
PreparedFilesystemAclContext explicitly bounds root preparation and states that it does not prove descendant ACLs, full-disk-read semantics, PE/DLL loading, registry or object-namespace confinement.
PreparedFilesystemToken binds token and root-ACL readback but explicitly does not prove image loading, private desktop, inherited handles or suspended Job containment.
FreshManagedRunnerBase observes a same-object managed base; it declares no conversion into filesystem or child-launch authority.

A controlled fixture can test these components using self-owned objects. It cannot by itself satisfy a Root=Read production profile, arbitrary outside-parent deletion boundaries or the original complete Core positive contract.

microsoft_sources.finding: Deletion or rename may be authorized by DELETE on the child or DELETE_CHILD on its parent. Both authorization routes matter; restricting only the protected child's ACL is insufficient.

WRITE_RESTRICTED applies the restricting SID set to write access. Ordinary full restriction requires both the enabled-SID and restricting-SID access checks; restricted applications also need an appropriate desktop boundary.
The ordinary and restricting SID passes must both grant access. A restricting SID list is not an assertion that each role independently granted an operation.

minimum_safe_closure_contract: Coordinate with the existing Windows owner on one source-bound production replacement. Do not treat the private SQLite branch, an ACL-idempotence repair or the separate refusal draft as a qualified sandbox implementation.

Preserve the requested read/write/deny profile and cover both child DELETE and parent DELETE_CHILD under the real effective token. Include protected descendants, arbitrary ambient grants, already-low-integrity owned outside fixtures, namespace/reparse/hard-link and ownership changes; retain original attack assertions.

Complete the permitted read/execute dependency closure and dedicated-account provenance, keeping filesystem, desktop, IPC and network roles separate. Validate same objects and token at final use, with bounded plan, explicit inherited handles and process-tree lifetime containment.

Use a source-bound, owner-created admission value only after its actual native prerequisites are satisfied. A pathname, user-writable marker, serialized receipt or test-only branch must not manufacture launch authority.

Run the unchanged original three Core positives and original negative matrix on native Windows, including cold setup, allowed reads, denied exact/glob reads, setup-marker preservation, absent metadata and UnifiedExec. Retain all failures and exact source/runtime/exit receipts.
Only after that source-bound qualification may the production guard be replaced by the proven admission path. No minimal fixture-only patch currently meets these requirements.
validation_limit: Available operator hosts reported by the repository audit owner are Linux/macOS, not native Windows. This review neither emulates Windows ACLs nor claims a native qualification. Hosted native verification is still required.
